proc toggleDiscordMute(): bool {....raises: [IOError, OSError, JsonParsingError,
    ValueError, LibraryError, SslError, CatchableError, LibraryError, OSError,
    SslError, IOError, JsonParsingError, ValueError, CatchableError,
    TimeoutError], tags: [ReadIOEffect, WriteIOEffect, ReadEnvEffect,
                          TimeEffect, ExecIOEffect, RootEffect, WriteDirEffect,
                          ReadDirEffect], forbids: [].}
Toggle the Discord client's self-mute and return the new mute state. The authenticated connection is kept open across calls because Discord rate-limits handshakes per client id: reconnecting on every press makes the second press hang, so a fresh connection is only made when the cached one has died (Discord restarted or closed the socket). Source   Edit
